what: Scilla, Nati 1892, atto 230 — born 6 October 1892, Via Grotte 75
correction: The tree gives his birth as 10 June 1892. Act 230 says he was born on 6 OCTOBER 1892 at Via Grotte 75 and was declared on the 9th. The 1892 index holds only one Arena Giuseppe, and the act names his mother as Concetta Russo, so this is the same child.

what: Scilla, Nati 1892, atto 230 — named as the father, aged 33, pescatore
correction: The tree gives his birth as 1870. Act 230 of 1892 makes him thirty-three in October 1892, so he was born about 1859 — eleven years earlier. His trade, which the tree does not record, is pescatore. HIS OWN BIRTH IS NOT AT SCILLA. The Tavola for 1857, 1858, 1859 and 1860 has been read in full -- four consecutive years, two either side of the window his son's act allows -- and there is no Giovanni Arena born in any of them. The next move is his marriage to Concetta Russo, which would name his comune of birth.

what: Scilla, Nati 1892, atto 230 — named as the mother, a filatrice
Scilla, Nati 1883, atto 206 — born 16 September 1883, Via Grotte 47
Scilla, Nati 1861 atto 228 and 1860 atto 45 — his birth, and his brother's
correction: RESOLVED. His parents are FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA, marinaro, and SERAFINA ARLOTTA, not Orazio Arena and Giovana Zirilli. The proof is a sibling pair: act 45 of 1860 gives Francesco Antonio and Serafina a son GIUSEPPE, act 228 of 1861 gives them a son ROCCO. The tree gives Orazio Arena exactly two children and they are ROCCO and GUISEPPE -- the same pair, same order, wrong father. Orazio's own children, across four years of the register, are Domenico, Domenico and Maria Annunziata. An Ellis Island manifest independently makes Rocco 39 in March 1900, consistent with a birth at the end of 1861.

what: Scilla, Nati 1856 atto 180 and 1859 atto 46 — two sons named Domenico
correction: The tree gives him no source at all, and gives him two children, Rocco and Guiseppe. THE REGISTER GIVES HIM NEITHER. Across 1856, 1858, 1859 and 1860 he and Giovanna Zirilli have Domenico (1856), Domenico (1859) and Maria Annunziata (1860); the Rocco and Giuseppe the tree assigns him belong to Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta. He is a real, well documented Scilla man who has been given another household's children. His first son being Domenico twice suggests, on naming custom alone, that his own father was a Domenico Arena -- a lead, not a finding.

what: Scilla, Nati 1856 atto 180 and 1859 atto 46 — named as the mother both times
correction: The export carries her twice as Orazio Arena's wife: undated here, and as Giovanna Zirilli b. 1827 with a son Guiseppe. Act 46 shows a single couple at Scilla in 1859. The two records have NOT been merged, because surname endogamy at Scilla is common enough that a second wife of the same surname is a real possibility.

what: Scilla, Nati 1859, atto 46 — named as the mother, with Orazio Arena
correction: See the duplicate record for Giovana Zirilli. The archive has left them unmerged pending Rocco Arena's actual birth act.

what: Scilla, Nati 1892, atto 162 — named as the father, aged 36, pescatore
correction: The tree puts his birth at Scilla in 1851. Act 162 of 1892 makes him THIRTY-SIX in July 1892, so born about 1856 -- and gives him a trade the tree does not record, pescatore. But the Scilla birth indexes for 1851, 1856 and 1859 each hold a complete D section and NONE of them has a Donato in it, while 1892 has two Donato households. On this evidence the surname arrives at Scilla between 1859 and 1892 and he was probably born in another comune. CONFIRMED INDEPENDENTLY: the New Orleans manifest of 1908 records him aged 52, off the Liguria -- a birth about 1856, agreeing with act 162 and not with the tree's 1851. And the 'Donato arrived at Scilla late' hypothesis is dead: fifteen Donato gave Scilla as their last residence at Ellis Island between 1893 and 1921.

what: Scilla, Nati 1892, atto 162 — born 6 July 1892, Via Grotte 31
correction: The act's marginal annotation records a death the tree does not have at all: she died at SCILLA on 26 AUGUST 1975, death act 30 of that year. Her daughters Angela and Giovanna are buried at Nudgee in Brisbane; their mother stayed at Scilla.

what: Scilla, Nati 1892, atto 162 — named as the mother, a filatrice
Scilla, Nati 1893, atto 22 — born 17 January 1893, Via Acquagrande 41
correction: The tree puts her crossing to America in 1894, when she was one. The Ellis Island manifest puts it at 23 MAY 1899, aged six, off the Archimede out of Naples -- and on the line immediately above hers is Giavanni Arena, 45, of Scilla. She travelled with him, not with her father, who arrived ten months later as a US citizen.

what: NAA passenger arrivals — the Ugolino Vivaldi, 1 March 1951, out of Genoa (candidate)

what: NAA passenger arrivals — placed on his mother's March 1951 voyage

what: Scilla, Nati 1860, atto 45 — born 5 March 1860
